texts: Whenever a Keeper retires, the Council staffs that Keeper's station again.
Whenever a Keeper dies, the Council staffs that Keeper's station again.
Letters from neighbouring villages are read aloud by the Council.

fields.sentence: Whenever a Keeper retires, the Council staffs that Keeper's station again.
parse: (: keeper_retire_staff (Implication (And (Member $e retire) (Agent $e $k) (Member $k keeper)) (And (Member (sk_staff $e) staff) (Agent (sk_staff $e) sk_council_1) (Patient (sk_staff $e) (sk_station $k)) (Member (sk_station $k) station) (Possession (sk_station $k) $k) (During (sk_staff $e) $e) (Again (sk_staff $e)))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Whenever-machinery applied correctly (plain-variable premises, per-occurrence Skolem consequent, During link, no QuantifierPhrase companion); "that Keeper's" is bound to the rule variable as donkey anaphora with a dependent Skolem station and possessed-first Possession, and "again" rides the opaque unary Again tag without asserting the prior staffing.

fields.sentence: Whenever a Keeper dies, the Council staffs that Keeper's station again.
parse: (: keeper_die_staff_rule (Implication (And (Member $k keeper) (Member $e die) (Patient $e $k)) (And (Member (sk_staff $e) staff) (Agent (sk_staff $e) sk_council_1) (Theme (sk_staff $e) (sk_station $k)) (Member (sk_station $k) station) (Possession (sk_station $k) $k) (Again (sk_staff $e)) (During (sk_staff $e) $e))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Whenever-rule shape, Skolem response event, During link, Again tag, donkey-bound possessor and top-level Council typing all follow the instruction set. 'staff' as Theme rides the explicit default-to-Theme licence, and the definite possessed NP's typing/Possession can only sit in the conclusion since premises may not contain Skolem terms.

fields.sentence: Letters from neighbouring villages are read aloud by the Council.
parse: (: letters_read_rule (Implication (And (Member $x letter) (From $x $v) (Member $v village) (Member $v neighbouring)) (And (Member (sk_read $x) read) (Agent (sk_read $x) sk_council_1) (Theme (sk_read $x) $x) (Manner (sk_read $x) aloud))) (STV 0.9 0.9))

q2_gaps: a bare plural inside an entity-attached oblique that restricts a generic-rule subject ("letters FROM NEIGHBOURING VILLAGES are read..."): the instruction set says an adjectivally-restricted kind subject forces the distributing-rule route with the restriction as a premise conjunct, but never extends that to a PP restriction, and the oblique's object-NP rule enumerates only article-mints-a-witness / bare mass / domain / proper name — nothing licenses turning a bare plural there into a universally-bound premise variable rather than a bare kind constant or a group witness
review.notes: Habitual-present passive with a bare-plural subject correctly takes the generic rule route at STV 0.9 0.9 with no QuantifierPhrase; `Agent` for the by-phrase, `Theme` for read (listed), the entity-attached `From` of origin, and the no-Name capitalized-common-noun treatment of "the Council" all match the instruction set.
